data.summary: Offline heuristic analysis (rule-based, no LLM) of 14 evidence block(s) from 1 document(s): found 14 functional and 9 non-functional requirement(s), 10 user stories, 3 entities and 8 endpoint suggestion(s). Retrieval was steered by the focus 'work order scheduling and dispatch'.
openQuestions: Clarify 'easy to' with a measurable criterion: "The mobile app should be easy to use with gloves on." (E13)
Should emergency work orders bypass the normal approval of overtime? (E14)
Integration with the ERP for parts stock levels is to be confirmed. (E14)

payload.name: WorkOrder
payload.description: Each work order has a reference number, customer, site address, priority (low, normal, high, emergency), status (new, scheduled, in progress, on hold, completed, cancelled), problem description, scheduled date and assigned technician.
